about: BRC-222 relationship vocabulary. The single source of truth: brc222.org's schema and page are generated from it (tools/build-vocabulary.py), and the Bridge Registry and Canopi vendor a copy. Each entry is an inverse pair, or a symmetric relationship that is its own inverse (symmetric: true, no inverse fields). 'A <name> B' and 'B <inverse> A' are the same bridge; it is stored in the canonical form, the entry's name, with the claim or described thing as the source. A symmetric relationship reads the same from either end. Aliases are accepted on input only (matching ignores case and punctuation) and are never output.

relationships.name: cites
relationships.label: cites
relationships.definition: The source quotes or references the target.
relationships.inverseDefinition: The source is quoted or referenced by the target.

relationships.name: isSupportedBy
relationships.label: supported by
relationships.definition: The target gives evidence or argument in favour of the source, which is typically a claim. The target need not be independent of it.
relationships.inverseDefinition: The source gives evidence or argument in favour of the target. The source need not be independent of it.

relationships.name: isCorroboratedBy
relationships.label: corroborated by
relationships.definition: The target independently confirms the source: a separate account, dataset or investigation reaching the same result.
relationships.inverseDefinition: The source independently confirms the target: a separate account, dataset or investigation reaching the same result.

relationships.name: contradicts
relationships.label: contradicts
relationships.definition: The source and the target are in tension, or inconsistent with each other. It does not say which of the two is right. It reads the same from either end.

relationships.name: isRefutedBy
relationships.label: refuted by
relationships.definition: The target shows the source to be false, with evidence.
relationships.inverseDefinition: The source shows the target to be false, with evidence.

relationships.name: isQualifiedBy
relationships.label: qualified by
relationships.definition: The target limits, conditions or distinguishes the source: it holds, but not as broadly or as simply as stated.
relationships.inverseDefinition: The source limits, conditions or distinguishes the target: it holds, but not as broadly or as simply as stated.

relationships.name: extends
relationships.label: extends
relationships.definition: The source builds on the target, taking its idea, method or finding further.
relationships.inverseDefinition: The source's idea, method or finding is taken further by the target.

relationships.name: isMemberOf
relationships.label: is a member of
relationships.definition: The source belongs to the collection, series, set or group the target describes.
relationships.inverseDefinition: The source is a collection, series, set or group that includes the target.
